subject.title: Require Codex scan artifact coverage proof

question: Should ClawHub enforce fail-closed `artifact_coverage` on benign Codex scan worker outputs after the zero-byte verifier bug and merge conflicts are fixed?
rationale: This changes the authoritative ClawScan trust boundary and can make previously accepted benign worker outputs fail closed, so the final contract needs maintainer/security-boundary intent beyond the mechanical fix.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Fix zero-byte full coverage, resolve current-main conflicts, and enforce artifact coverage proof as the new benign-worker contract.

options.title: Stage compatibility first
options.body: Keep existing storage behavior while adding diagnostics or dry-run coverage checks before switching to fail-closed enforcement.

options.title: Pause enforcement
options.body: Keep this draft paused or replace it with a narrower contract-design issue until maintainers settle the permanent worker-output contract.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Fix zero-byte full coverage, resolve current-main conflicts, and enforce artifact coverage proof as the new benign-worker contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent current-main changes to the worker and scan-request paths that would absorb this contract.
